_readme: Mode profile for DIRECT mode: a visitor talks to Panganiban (cj-alpha); the Host (cj-beta) says its intro line, then stays silent. Values here are the base of the resolution order: mode profile -> systemd drop-in -> app/.env -> console override. Keep secrets out of this file. Keys under `profiles` override `defaults` for the selected profile (kiosk | event). Setting -> robot env mapping lives in dashboard/console.py (SETTING_ENV).
host_intro_text: Good day. I am your host for today. Chief Justice Panganiban will take your questions — say 'Hi Cee-Jap' to begin.

kiosk._note: Museum floor, self-service. Same values as the 2026-09-02 drop-in so behaviour is unchanged on first deploy.

event._note: Emcee-driven hall. No wake word (questions come from the /event buttons or the console), higher speech level so a crowd does not hold the mic open, and no post-answer window.
